denominator.definition: Unplanned ECDS attendances in the annual national attendance-source table.

ae-attendance.label: All ECDS attendances in the route table

self-presentation.label: Self-referral
self-presentation.definition: Combined from the two published self-referral SNOMED categories.

nhs111-ae-route.label: NHS 111 referral
nhs111-ae-route.definition: Referred by National Health Service 111 service.

gp-ae-route.label: Primary health care team referral
gp-ae-route.definition: Referred by a member of the Primary Health Care Team; this is broader than GP referral alone.

ambulance-ae-route.label: Ambulance service referral
ambulance-ae-route.definition: Attendance source recorded as referral by the ambulance service.

secondary.label: Arrived by ambulance
secondary.definition: Arrival mode, which is separate from attendance source.

other-professional-route.label: Other recorded attendance sources
other-professional-route.definition: All recorded attendance-source categories other than self-referral, NHS 111, primary health care team, ambulance service and Not Known.
